messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the one-piece garment and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman stands with her back to the camera, then raises her right hand to brush her hair back before lowering it and shifting her weight slightly.","camera":"The camera starts in a medium shot from behind and slowly zooms out to a full-body shot, remaining static otherwise.","clothing":"She wears a white, three-quarter-sleeve romper with a floral print of pink, yellow, and blue flowers, featuring cold-shoulder cutouts and a low V-shaped back.","hair_color":"Black.","hairstyle":"Her hair is pulled back into two small low buns or pigtails at the nape of her neck.","identity":"A slim woman with dark brown skin, seen from behind, with a slender build and long legs.","scene":"She stands on a stone-paved pier or dock next to a calm body of water under a clear, bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The red long-sleeve top and white skirt were replaced by a white floral one-piece romper with pink, yellow, and blue flowers, cold-shoulder cutouts, and a low V back. The black boots were replaced by reddish-brown low shoes with white soles. Hair, hairstyle, body, pose, camera movement, and seaside scene remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person's entire outfit with the reference outfit: a white floral one-piece garment with cold-shoulder cutouts and matching reddish-brown shoes, removing the original top, skirt, and boots while preserving non-clothing attributes.
uncertain: Exact shoe model and color match to the reference is difficult to confirm from the distance and lighting.
unexpected_changes: The original two-piece outfit was converted into a one-piece romper, as required by the reference, but the lower garment now appears integrated with the top rather than a separate skirt.
